Name: Luck Controller
Author: Hristov75
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Over 600 of the game's chance rolls and about 380 loot tables become settings: geodes, fishing, forage, monster drops, mine floors, the traveling cart, animal births, festivals and more. Everything starts on Vanilla, so nothing changes until you choose to. [/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI 4.0+ (Stardew Valley 1.6) if you don't already have it
2. Install the mod
3. Unzip the mod into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder
4. Press "F10" (the default hotkey) in game and the menu will open.


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

1) Set any chance to Never, Always, a custom % or a multiplier
2) Pick exactly which item drops, which fish bites, which mine layout you get
3) Choose the traveling cart's stock, prices and amounts
4) Community Center and Perfection helpers that steer rolls toward items you still need

And many more...

The rule: only results the unmodded game could also produce. If the game decides something without a random roll, the mod leaves it alone and tells you why the setting didn't work. This allows for some crazy theoretical outcomes. For example a mine floor with every tile being a slime monster - extremely unlikely but theoretically possible so the mod allows it. There are things in the game that are forced though and don't rely on luck so the mod doesn't touch them.


[b][size=4]HELP WANTED![/size][/b]

This is a beta project created by me alone and i have no programming experience so it was was made with the help of Claude. Im sure there are still a lot of bugs to be fixed and improvements that can be made but doing it by myself would take ages so if anyone who downloads the mod could report any bugs features not working properly/as expected or just has an idea on how to make things better I would be happy to hear it.

Email: samuelhristov07@gmail.com

Please provide as much information as possible for the bug you encountered or the feature ideas you may have so that I have an easier time fixing/implementing them.

Tested on Windows only. Mods that change the same rolls (Total Luck Control, More Ores, CJB luck options...) may conflict.
